topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I see, the building is transitioning to condos. That's a significant change, but let's break it down step by step. First, it’s important to understand what this means for you and your lease. Take a moment to review any provisions in your lease about such a transition. It’s also a good idea to reach out to the management to clarify your rights and options. They should provide information on the process and how it will affect current tenants. You might have the option to purchase your unit or negotiate the terms of your stay. Whatever the case, keep your questions clear and your concerns organized. This approach will help you make informed decisions.
